summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute bundled obfuscated payload
details: The package declares a preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) that, when no local `bun` binary is found, downloads the Bun v1.3.13 runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases into a temp directory, extracts it, chmods it executable, and invokes it against a sibling file `math_init.js` shipped in the tarball. `math_init.js` is a ~727 KB heavily obfuscated bundle (banner `// @bun @bun-cjs`) using a rotated numeric/string constant array and a runtime string decoder (`WV8StW`/`hc1jfK9`) to reconstruct identifiers and network endpoints; no destinations appear as plain literals. The package is published as a CSS/styles library, for which fetching a second language runtime at install time to execute a large opaque binary-like payload is inconsistent with the stated purpose. Executing the payload under a freshly-downloaded Bun binary rather than under Node bypasses Node-based install-time inspection.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
